admission.justification: Prevents a caller from reporting a changed field, parent or value the operation did not write.

applicability: Admitted set_field calls with supported mutable fields, set_status calls with a supplied status, and set_step calls with supplied update keys.
conditions: set_field renders only the actual mutable-field allowlist; ignored fields are not reported changed.
set_status renders the supplied status. set_step identifies its step and supplied parent when present, and renders only supplied supported update keys.
Each rendered value is bounded by the phrase formatter; a set_step payload with no supported update keys has only the generic addressed-step summary.
exclusions: append_decision, record_review and record_route_review have fixed summaries (decision appended or review recorded), not this changed-value guarantee.

create/replace, add/remove/skip-step, subtask/section, execution-graph, master/archive and linkage operations retain their own operation-specific phrase contracts and are outside this three-operation scope.
The phrase is not the complete rendered document, aggregate diff, implicit approval, observed execution or a guarantee for every changed-unit operation.

evidence: TaskDocPhraseTests green: /tmp/mik-run3/L111/a06_fast.txt (65 passed, 78 subtests, exit 0); round-8 verdict notes/reports/reviewer/4889df77-3c01-4cc7-a6ae-344b459490bd/round-8/verdict.md

statement: For task_doc set_field, set_status and set_step operations that supply values to their supported formatter branches, the update phrase identifies the field or addressed step and carries bounded new values.
